Uttar Pradesh ODOP Training and Toolkit Scheme: Overview and Application Details

04 Nov 2026, 04:14 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: www.govtschemes.in

2 min read

Key takeawaysThe Uttar Pradesh ODOP Training and Toolkit Scheme is a government initiative under the One District One Product (ODOP) programme, aimed at supporting traditional artisans and craftsmen by improving their technical skills and providing modern equipment.

The Uttar Pradesh ODOP Training and Toolkit Scheme is a government initiative under the One District One Product (ODOP) programme, aimed at supporting traditional artisans and craftsmen by improving their technical skills and providing modern equipment.

Key Benefits of the Scheme

  • Free Training: Eligible artisans receive 10 days of non-residential skill development and entrepreneurship training at no cost.
  • Daily Honorarium: Trainees are provided ₹200 per day, totaling up to ₹2,000 for the 10 payable days, transferred directly to their bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) upon satisfactory completion.
  • Advanced Toolkits: Beneficiaries receive a product-specific advanced toolkit valued at up to ₹20,000.
  • Certification: Experienced artisans can undergo assessment and certification by the relevant Sector Skill Council through Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).

Eligibility Criteria

To qualify for the scheme, applicants must meet specific requirements:

  • Must be a native of Uttar Pradesh.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age on the date of application.
  • Must be actively engaged in producing the designated ODOP product of their district.
  • There is no formal educational qualification requirement.
  • The benefit is restricted to one person per family (defined as husband and wife) and can be availed only once.
  • Applicants must not have received a similar toolkit from any central or state government scheme in the past two years.

Application Process

Applicants can apply online through the official Directorate of Industries portal. Those facing technical difficulties can seek assistance at their nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to submit the form. Essential documents typically include a caste certificate (if applicable) and a signed declaration or affidavit confirming eligibility. A district-level selection committee, chaired by the Deputy Commissioner of Industries, reviews submissions and selects eligible candidates.

Verification and Official Contacts

Interested individuals should verify official notifications, guidelines, and application links directly through the Directorate of Industries, Uttar Pradesh portal. For official queries, applicants can contact the Directorate of Industries helpline at 155343 or through designated department phone numbers.
